title: SignalWatch Disruption & Safety Alerts
description: Structured schema for real-time safety disruption alerts, severe weather warnings, flood advisories, and emergency bulletins.

supportedIntents.description: Queries requesting live safety advisories, meteorological warnings, flood risks, heat watches, or disruption status for a specific city, state, or current location.
example: is there a heat advisory in Phoenix

hazardType.description: Hazard classification such as flood, tornado, heat, winter storm, severe weather, wind, fire, or hurricane.

severity.description: Severity level: Extreme, Severe, Moderate, Minor, or Unknown.

schema.description: Query object defining the safety disruption request.

filters.description: Filters to target specific hazards or severity ratings.
